Episode 29 of a daily journey through the universe. ☀️
We come home to the Sun: 99.8% of the solar system's mass, 1.3 million Earths inside, a 15-million-degree core, light that takes thousands of years to escape, and 4 million tons turned into energy every second.

segments.text: Episode twenty-nine. Next stop... the Sun.
The Sun holds about ninety-nine point eight percent of all the mass in our solar system.
segments.headline: 99.8% of everything

segments.text: About one point three million Earths could fit inside it.
Its core is about fifteen million degrees Celsius.
Light made in the core can take tens of thousands of years to escape. Then, just eight minutes to reach you.
segments.headline: Old light, fast trip

segments.text: Every second, it turns about four million tons of matter into pure energy.
segments.headline: 4 million tons a second

segments.text: Tomorrow, we see what happens when the Sun gets angry, and why people saw auroras over Mexico. Next stop: solar storms. Follow, so you don't miss episode thirty.
